Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 这是古代的故事：这是一个古代的故事
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 从他的家到墓地很近：他的家离墓地很近
- 所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿：delete老是；玩儿，V.V. is used to make requests or plans

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 玩玩儿：玩，the reduplicated form suggests playing only briefly or casually, which conflicts with the long duration expressed by “从早到晚”.
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他的家：孟子的家，repeat the name after another male character, “爸爸”, has appeared; this makes the possessor of the home unambiguous.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他每天：孟子每天，repeat the name when the immediately preceding sentence also mentions his father, so the pronoun cannot be read as referring to the father.

items.reason: 玩玩儿的动词重叠不适合表示“从早到晚”这样长时间的活动。
这里的“他的家”可清楚指孟子，且教师改写时也保留了“他的家”。
“他”仍可自然指孟子，教师也保留了这个代词；改后句子还保留了不当的“老是”和“玩玩儿”。
